name: Standard Visitor visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave the UK at the end of your visit, and that you won't live in the UK for extended periods through frequent or successive visits.

value.note: no fixed minimum published — must show ability to support self and dependants during the trip and pay for the return/onward journey, or have funding from someone else

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being able to support yourself and any dependants during the trip, and pay for your return or onward journey — or have funding from someone else to do so.
This does not permit paid or unpaid work for a UK company or as a self-employed person, unless doing a permitted paid engagement or event.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds (bank statements, sponsor letter)
Evidence of ties to home country and intent to leave the UK (employment, property, family ties)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: cannot live in the UK for extended periods through frequent or successive visits, or make the UK a main home

sources.title: Visit the UK as a Standard Visitor: Overview - GOV.UK

notes: Fee £135 confirmed via direct fetch of gov.uk (page updated 2026-08-04, i.e. 4 days before this verification) — several secondary sources still show £115 (pre-2025) or £127 (April 2025-March 2026), another clean counterfeit-figure case. This is the first 'visit' category route encoded in the dataset — deliberately closes that gap. Genuinely terminal: no switchable_to targets, cannot be extended or switched into another route from inside the UK, and does not count toward any settlement path — a real structural difference from every work/study/family route encoded so far, and the correct behavior, not a gap. Study rights marked 'restricted' because visitors may study for up to 30 days recreationally or take short courses/exams/placements, but cannot use this route for substantive study — that belongs to uk_student. duration_type is 'per_entry' rather than 'fixed' since each visit is capped independently at 6 months, not a single continuous grant like most other routes. Whether a visa is needed at all depends on nationality (visa national list vs ETA vs visa-free) — this file assumes the visa-required case; a genuinely complete model would need a NationalVariable-style lookup of visa-national status per country, not yet built.
